name: PDM agent — train existing device
description: Resolves an existing device, trains forecast+anomaly models, infers, and reports predictions without creating a device.

parts.text: Train a predictive maintenance model on device "PdM-Machine-1" using its vibration telemetry. Forecast with lstm and detect anomalies with random_forest over the last 30 days, then run inference and give me the prediction counts.
Training complete. Forecast: 30 predictions (latest 2026-07-13). Anomalies: 2 flagged (latest 2026-07-12).
